deviations.decision: PASS_WITH_DEVIATION — proceed; logged here, in OPERATOR/COMMENTS.md, and in Risk-And-Audit-Log
deviations.detail: solver spec qmdj_reference expects chart-analyst v4 hashes; the package was produced by chart_analyser.yaml v5.0.0 (supplied at runtime by the orchestrator).
